description: Look up any game and find what to play next - RAWG search, ratings, franchise order, and tag-matched recommendations with remake-aware title resolution, built for agents.

novel_features.name: Similar Games
novel_features.description: Games like <title>: the seed's own studio first, then its defining gameplay tag (roguelite, metroidvania) found by tag-neighborhood co-occurrence, then a confidence-floored genre join. Every row carries its tier and a reason.

novel_features.name: Retention Verdict
novel_features.description: Community completion and drop verdict for one game from RAWG added_by_status counts (needs RAWG_API_KEY).

novel_features_built.description: Decision-debt audit of your local backlog: unplayed %, median shelf-time, status ratios, plus stale, sunk-cost, and drop-candidate rows with follow-up recommendations.
Finish-rate dashboard over your backlog: finished %, monthly completion rate, months-to-zero-backlog projection, and 10% milestone checkpoints naming the next game to finish.
Upcoming releases from the next 90 days scored by genre overlap with your backlog-derived taste profile (needs RAWG_API_KEY; degrades to plain recency without it).
Community completion and drop verdict for one game from RAWG added_by_status counts (needs RAWG_API_KEY).
